Sales Executive Job at Soft Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        Soft Solutions Limited specialises in offering customised solutions tailored to our customers' unique needs. Whether it's IT infrastructure, network security, cloud migration, or software licensing, we provide bespoke services designed to optimise your operations and support your business goals.Our expert team works closely with you to understand your specific requirements and deliver solutions that enhance efficiency, security, and productivity.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Executive
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time (Hybrid)

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Identify and generate new business opportunities and qualified leads.
	Promote and sell the company's IT solutions and services to prospective clients.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
	Conduct client meetings, presentations, product demonstrations, and sales pitches.
	Understand customer requirements and collaborate with the Pre-Sales/Technical team to propose suitable solutions.
	Prepare proposals, quotations, and other sales documents.
	Manage sales opportunities from lead generation through negotiation and closing.
	Maintain accurate sales records and provide regular pipeline and sales reports.
	Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling to existing clients.
	Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging technology solutions.
	Achieve assigned sales and revenue targets.


Requirements


	Possess a Bachelor's Degree / HND in Business Administration, Marketing, IT, Computer Science, or a related field with 3 – 5 years of experience in sales, business development, or IT solution sales.
	Good understanding of IT solutions, cybersecurity, software, networking, or related technologies.
	Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
	Strong business development and customer acquisition abilities.
	Target-driven, proactive, and results-oriented.
	Experience in B2B / corporate sales is an added advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and application letter to: [email protected] with the Job Position as the subject of the mail

title: Job Openings at Zurishaddai Recruitment Agency
content:
Zurishaddai Recruitment Agency is a one stop shop for attracting the right talent for the best offered opportunities. With a cumulative wealth of experience spanning over Eight (8) years, premium value delivery and satisfied clients' testimonials have become our culture. We have become excellent professionals at sourcing for both mid-level and entry level job positions for small-scale and growing businesses with a track record of producing results and matching the right candidates to our clients' requirements.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Senior Sales and Marketing Manager
     

            
    



Job Location: Ikota-Ajah, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: MD / CEO

Job Overview


	We are a leading real estate company in Lagos seeking a seasoned Senior Sales and Marketing Manager to spearhead our sales and marketing efforts.
	If you're a results-driven professional with a passion for real estate, we would love to hear from you.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing sales strategies to meet business objectives, building and maintaining strong relationships with potential and existing clients, and identifying new business opportunities.


Key Responsibilities
Sales Strategy:


	Develop and execute sales strategies to meet business objectives.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with potential and existing clients.


Marketing:


	Develop and implement marketing campaigns to promote our properties and services.
	Manage social media platforms and create engaging content.


Business Development:


	Identify new business opportunities and build relationships with key stakeholders.
	Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive business growth.


Requirements
Qualifications:


	Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field.
	Proven experience in sales and marketing within the real estate industry.


Skills:


	Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
	Strong knowledge of the real estate market and industry trends.
	Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary range: N300,000 - N500,000 gross per month.
	Opportunities for career growth and development.
	Collaborative and dynamic work environment.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

 

 

2.) Sales & Marketing Executive

Job Location: Ikota - Ajah, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Company: Coatings, Real Estate & Roofing Company

About the Role


	We are looking for a passionate and result-driven Sales & Marketing Executivesto drive revenue growth across our 3 business lines: Paints & Coatings, Real Estate, and Roofing.
	You will be responsible for generating leads, closing deals, managing client relationships, and building the brand presence in Lekki/Ajah and beyond.


Key Responsibilities
Sales:


	Identify and pursue new business opportunities for coatings, roofing materials, and real estate properties
	Conduct site visits, product presentations, and property inspections for clients
	Meet and exceed monthly sales targets across all 3 divisions
	Negotiate contracts and close deals with developers, contractors, homeowners, and investors
	Manage the full sales cycle from lead generation to after-sales service


Marketing:


	Develop and execute marketing strategies to promote coatings, roofing products, and real estate listings
	Manage digital marketing: social media, WhatsApp broadcasts, Google/FB ads, property portals
	Organize activations, site tours, exhibitions, and agent/agent partnerships
	Build and maintain relationships with architects, builders, realtors, and facility managers
	Prepare marketing materials, brochures, proposals, and reports


General:


	Maintain CRM database and pipeline reports
	Conduct market research on competitors, pricing, and trends in coatings, roofing, and real estate in Lagos
	Represent the company professionally at all times


Requirements


	BSc / HND in Marketing, Business, or related field. Relevant certifications an advantage
	Minimum 3+ years of YOEin sales & marketing, preferably in Building Materials, Coatings, Roofing, or Real Estate
	Proven track record of meeting/exceeding sales targets
	Strong knowledge of Lagos property market, especially Lekki-Ajah corridor
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and closing skills
	Tech savvy: MS Office, CRM tools, Canva, and social media ads
	Must have own means of mobility and be resident in Lagos
	Self-motivated, target-driven, and able to work with little supervision.


What We Offer


	Competitive, negotiable salary+ commission structure
	Career growth in a multi-service company
	Support with leads, marketing materials, and branding
	Conducive work environment in Ikota, Ajah.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Sales & Marketing Executive - Ikota" as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only qualified candidates will be contacted.

 

 

3.) Growth & Digital Marketing Executive

Job Location: Ikota, Ajah - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are looking for a results-driven Growth & Digital Marketing Executive to lead customer acquisition and grow our brand across all business units.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and run digital marketing strategies across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, SEO, and email
	Generate and nurture high-quality leads through organic + paid campaigns

	Work with sales to improve lead quality and conversion rates

	Lead generation, CPL, conversion rate, website traffic, ROAS, SEO growth, and revenue contribution.

	Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field
	Minimum 3 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, or lead generation
	Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and email marketing
	Knowledge of SEO, SEM, content marketing, and social media
	Proficient with Google Analytics, CRM, and marketing automation tools
	Strong analytical, copywriting, and communication skills
	Results-driven and able to manage multiple campaigns.

N400,000 / month.

title: Job Openings at Coronation Merchant Bank
content:
Coronation Merchant Bank is a Africa’s premier investment bank, providing innovative solutions to the needs of corporations, governments and other financial services organisations.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) FX Trader

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Coronation Merchant Bank is seeking an experienced FX Dealer to join our Treasury team, executing foreign exchange transactions and managing currency risk in line with market opportunities and regulatory requirements.


What you'll be involved in
     

            
    




	Executing spot, forward, and swap FX transactions for the Bank and clients
	Monitoring FX market trends, rates, and liquidity conditions in real time
	Managing the Bank's FX trading positions within approved limits
	Pricing and quoting rates for corporate and institutional clients
	Ensuring compliance with CBN FX guidelines and internal risk/trading policies
	Building and maintaining relationships with counterparties, correspondent banks, and clients
	Collaborating with Treasury Sales, Risk, and Settlements teams on trade execution and reporting


What we're looking for


	Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field
	3+ years of experience as an FX Dealer within a bank or financial institution
	Strong understanding of the Nigerian FX market and CBN regulatory framework
	Proven track record in FX trading and risk management
	Strong numerical, analytical, and decision-making skills under pressure
	Relevant certifications (ACI Dealing Certificate or similar) an advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

 

 

2.) Chief Economist

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full Time

Summary


	Coronation Merchant Bank is seeking an accomplished Chief Economist to lead our economic research and market intelligence function, providing strategic insight that informs the Bank's investment, lending, and advisory decisions.


What you'll own


	Macroeconomic research, forecasting, and analysis (Nigerian and global markets)
	Producing economic reports, market commentary, and thought leadership publications
	Advising Executive Management and the Board on macroeconomic trends and their business implications
	Monitoring fiscal and monetary policy developments and assessing impact on the Bank's strategy
	Supporting Treasury, Investment Banking, and other business teams with economic insight for decision-making
	Representing the Bank at industry forums, media engagements, and investor briefings
	Building and leading the research team.


What we're looking for


	Advanced Degree in Economics, Finance, or a related field (Master's or PhD preferred)
	8+ years of experience in economic research, ideally within banking, asset management, or a multilateral/policy institution
	Deep knowledge of the Nigerian economy, fiscal/monetary policy, and financial markets
	Strong track record of published research, market commentary, or public economic analysis
	Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including media/public engagement experience
	Strong leadership and stakeholder management capability.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

 

3.) Relationship Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full Time

Role Description


	The Relationship Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Lagos, responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of corporate and institutional clients.
	Day-to-day tasks include developing and maintaining strong client relationships, understanding client needs, and recommending suitable banking, investment, and wealth management solutions.
	The role involves preparing and delivering proposals, coordinating credit and transaction processes, and ensuring timely execution of client mandates.
	The Relationship Manager will monitor account performance, identify cross-selling opportunities, and collaborate with product, risk, and operations teams to provide seamless client service.
	The position also requires regular market research, participation in client meetings and events, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance standards.


Qualifications


	Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CFA, ACCA, ICAN) are an advantage.
	Relevant experience in relationship management, corporate banking, or financial services, preferably within a merchant or investment banking environment.
	Strong client relationship management skills, with the ability to build trust, understand business needs, and provide tailored financial solutions.
	Solid knowledge of corporate banking, investment banking, and global markets products, and the ability to explain these offerings clearly to clients.
	Analytical and financial modeling skills, including the ability to interpret financial statements, assess credit risk, and prepare high-quality proposals.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with strong attention to detail and professional writing ability.
	Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, manage multiple priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
	Good understanding of regulatory requirements, compliance standards, and risk management practices in the Nigerian financial sector.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
